# Draft:Dal Kumari Sunuwar

----
Dal Kumari Sunuwar is a former Nepali lawmaker and a representative of the Sunuwar indigenous community. She served as a member of the Constituent Assembly, nominated by the Rastriya Prajatantra Party (RPP) from the Ramechhap district.
Role in the Constituent Assembly: As an indigenous representative, she raised concerns about the exclusion of indigenous languages in the assembly's decision-making processes, highlighting that many members could not properly articulate their ideas in Nepali.
Advocacy: She is a vocal champion of indigenous rights and has participated in events, such as World Indigenous Day, where she was pictured in traditional Sunuwar attire.
Affiliations: She has been associated with the Women's Caucus, a group of women members in the Constituent Assembly working on incorporating women's rights and an equality agenda into the new constitution
